blocks.text: The Thai government is pressing ahead with efforts to upgrade the country’s tourism industry and make it a key driver of sustainable economic growth, deputy government spokesperson Lalida Periswiwatana announced on Saturday (October 31, 2026). At its second meeting of 2026, chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Suphajee Suthumpun, the National Tourism Policy Committee discussed the approach to drafting the Fourth National Tourism Development Plan (2028–2032), which aims to increase the economic value of tourism. The draft plan focuses on improving the quality of tourism products and services, expanding markets for visitors with high spending power and distributing income to small businesses […]...
